'''Esca Bulbs''' are blocks that produce light.  They can be dyed in the crafting menu.

==''Obtainment''==
{{CraftingTable|r1_b1=Fish|r1_a2=Infected Flesh|r1_b2=Sea Lantern|r1_c2=Infected Flesh|r1_b3=Fish|r1_output=Esca Bulb|r1_count=4}}

==''Usage''==
Esca Bulbs produce a large amount of light (around 14 levels, comparable to a Torch), and are uniquely the only large light emitting block that cannot be detected by parasites in [[Generations#Generation 5|Generation 5]].
